configuration.checkpoint_policy: append durable events and atomically refresh status every 100 completed rows per phase
configuration.identity_policy: each source row is reconstructed from metadata and checked against canonical_sha256; no rank join
configuration.negative_policy: a replay INFEASIBLE result is not a claim; fixed-span CP-SAT checks every legal span, and UNKNOWN remains unresolved
configuration.reported_span_policy: reuse a valid replay certificate only at the recorded span, otherwise fixed-span CP-SAT

identity_join: stored canonical_sha256; phase-local rank and candidate_id are reporting-only
